name: Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance
old_description: Since 1978, we have been supplying our customers with not only the auto parts they seek, but a level of customer service and commitment unmatched. And you don’t have to be an auto dealer or auto repair facility to buy the auto parts you need. Stop by and see us and one of our friendly Parts Specialists will help you out.
about:
Aftermarket Auto Parts Alliance is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, and has operated since 1978 as a network of independent warehouse distributors, parts stores, and repair shops across North America and beyond. The company operates under the Auto Value and Bumper to Bumper brands, serving as a distribution and marketing program group for the automotive aftermarket.

The alliance coordinates a network of roughly 3,500 certified service centers and thousands of parts stores across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Honduras, Colombia, Belize, Europe, and China. It provides warranty programs including the Confidence Plus North American Warranty and SafeRoute Roadside Assistance, an online ordering platform called MyPlace4Parts for repair shops, and carries manufacturer lines such as Perfect Stop, Parts Master, Perfect View, MacPherson, Ultra Stop, and Auto Body Master.

Its customers are independent automotive repair shops, warehouse distributors, and retail parts stores that rely on the alliance for parts supply, technical training, marketing support, and business management tools. The network emphasizes local ownership, with each warehouse distributor independently owned and operated.

The company was founded on a service-first philosophy, summarized in its tagline "SERVICE is the difference. We get it!" It differentiates itself by responding to individual customer needs and providing products and service through a global network of independent members.
